reviews.comment: Even though he does not teach many undergrad classes, I really enjoyed this course with Dr. Klein! A funny, understanding, and knowledgeable professor with vast remote sensing experience. Class material is very tough, but he is ready to answer any questions you have and attending lectures was a must if you wanted to pass the comprehensive exams.

Dr. Klein is brilliant and teaches a lot of difficult material. GIS itself is just difficult, but he explains it very well. He grades fairly and believes in teaching his students how to work professionally with your peers/professors. This class is a lot of work, but as long as you keep up and reach out to him for help, you'll do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Klein is a really good professor for GIS. He grades very fairly, but the material itself is just difficult. There are a lot of labs and content to keep up with, but he offers extra credit and is very easy to approach outside of class. Put in the work and you'll gain a lot from his class!
As long as you attend the lectures, you should be able to pass the class. I have not had to use the book assigned for class but the lab manual is very crucial so if nothing else, get that book.
